carmen: FYI deployed a targeted microbatch + kvcache tweak to a 10% canary (prod-green) at 10:12 UTC to address bursty short-request tail and wasted microbatch cost.
jia: short summary?
carmen: two small config changes: (1) microbatcher now aggressively coalesces windows <=8 tokens when QPS < 50; (2) kvcache low-water threshold lowered from 20% to 8% for hot-prefix routes to avoid premature evictions during brief surges.
mike: did you validate with the live-replay mix? numbers?
carmen: ran 60m live replay against canary vs baseline. Key results for requests <32 tokens: p50 went from 7ms to 3ms (~55% drop), p95 from 33ms to 26ms (~21% drop), p99 from 210ms to 170ms (~19% drop). Token cost per 1M tokens down ~12% under same load (fewer microbatch filler tokens).
sofia: any negative impact on long-seq traffic or heavy kv churn?
carmen: saw a small p99 uptick for >1024 token requests on a single shard (210ms -> 230ms). Root cause: that shard was still on an older kernel image leading to a scheduling stall when microbatcher drained. Not seen cluster-wide.
mike: can you paste the exact config rolled so QE can reproduce?
carmen: sure. Config snippet rolled (pasted in thread): ```json {
  "microbatch": {"max_window_tokens": 8, "aggressive_coalesce_qps": 50},
  "kvcache": {"low_water_pct": 8}
} ```
mike: thanks. I patched the remaining nodes with the newer kernel on staging and re-ran a targeted long-seq replay at 10x traffic, no regressions after kernel bump. Ops should schedule patch for the remaining prod nodes.
sofia: ops-bot, link to dashboards and perf-run id?
ops-bot: Canary dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/canary/1756678901 - Perf run id: perf_2026_03_22_1012 - baseline vs canary traces attached. :white_check_mark:
jia: rollout plan? staged or full flip?
carmen: propose staged region-by-region over 6h with rollback flags: 1) patch remaining kernel images on 3 nodes, 2) expand canary to 30% for 1h, 3) run smoke harness including long-seq p99 gate, 4) flip to 100% if green. I'll add a checklist and a changelog note.
mike: please add a p99 long-seq threshold to the smoke harness alerts so we catch that regression quickly.
sofia: scheduling ops window at 23:00 UTC, @mike @jia ok?
mike: ok. jia: yes.
jia: I'll document the kvcache low_water_pct semantics in the perf playbook so SRE and QE know the tradeoffs.
carmen: TL;DR: small microbatch + kvcache floor tweak yields substantial improvements on short-request latency and ~12% token cost savings in replay; minor long-seq tail on an old-kernel shard fixed by kernel patch; staged rollout tonight. Will post final notes and artifacts after full rollout. :tada:
